column1: # What the differential test compiles and runs, pinned by the SHA-256 of its bytes with CRLF
# read as LF (the BepInEx row: the bytes as they are). Columns: role, repo path, sha256, source.

# pre-release. Its reader calls no cameraunlock-core source: every default is a literal or a
# PluginInfo constant, and the frozen copy spells those constants out in a nested class.

# PluginInfo.cs at its tag and calling Initialize on a ConfigFile with no file, as BaseUnityPlugin
# builds it, on BepInEx 5.4.23.5 under .NET Framework 4.8 with a KeyCode enum holding every name
# in core's data/keys.json. Only the '# Acceptable values' comment lines depend on that enum.
